## What does this change, and why?

## Checklist
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] `python tests/fuzz.py 3000` reports 0 crashes
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests, including a bad-input case with a friendly error
- [ ] Docs updated (code blocks in `docs/` are run by the tests; use `python tools/docs_fill.py`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for it
- [ ] If it changes the language itself: there is an accepted proposal (`docs/proposals/`)
